purpose: Validate complete scenario step shapes and matchers before the runner starts.
behavior: Checks action argument types, allowed extra-key values, action-specific expectation fields, process-entry keys and line piece shapes.
Accepts tagged nonfinite command-option numbers for cross-language invalid-input cases while per-step counts must be unsigned integers.
Validates the shared regex subset and uses command.hex_bytes for input and hex matchers.
contracts: Malformed fixtures are harness failures and cannot be pending; only the eight enumerated error codes and five enumerated exit reasons are accepted.
dependencies: runner/scenario.rs limits action keys; names.rs checks references; command.rs translates option values.
failures_or_limits: REASONS omits memory_exceeded although expect.rs emits that reason for MemoryExceeded; scenarios cannot express that expected reason here. Reused hex parsing accepts an odd final hex nibble.

purpose: Run sorted applicable conformance scenarios and enforce pending-ledger policy.
behavior: Loads and validates every JSON scenario before deciding OS/language applicability, with a fresh LocalSet for each executed scenario.
Aggregates success by item across applicable cases; only a product failure for a pending item increments pending rather than errors.
Tracks passed, pending, executed, filtered and file counts and adds ledger errors for unknown or stale waivers.
contracts: Harness failures always fail the suite even for pending items; an empty scenario directory is an assertion failure.
dependencies: ledger.rs parses/checks waivers; scenario.rs validates/applicability; runner/mod.rs executes each scenario.
failures_or_limits: Nonapplicable valid cases do not contribute to item success; read_dir and entry failures panic. Printed counts describe a future run, not results from this analysis.

purpose: Test the contract harness itself so pending entries cannot conceal malformed fixtures or regex drift.
behavior: Checks a failing pending item stays pending while stale, unknown, duplicate and malformed ledger entries fail.
Creates eleven temporary scenarios, including malformed late steps after an earlier product failure, and expects exactly one pending product case plus ten bad-scenario errors.
Reads the shared regex table and checks accepted matches, nonmatches, first capture groups, and refused patterns.
contracts: This test is a separate binary so contract remains alone when it sets an environment variable before creating threads.
dependencies: runner/suite.rs and ledger.rs supply the policy under test; conformance/regex-table.json is the differential fixture.
failures_or_limits: The test source asserts expected totals but was not run. Missing regex table lists default to empty, so fixture integrity depends on the maintained table.
